titulo: Review of the tenses: The past tenses

aula.objetivo: Review and compare the B1 tenses: the past (present perfect, preterite, imperfect, pluperfect), the future, probability, the conditional, «si» hypotheses and the subjunctive, choosing each tense by the idea you want to express.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: ask first: is the action finished and do I place it at a definite time (ayer, el año pasado, en 2019)? Then use the preterite: «Ayer compré pan», «Nació en 2001». STEP 2: is the action a past habit, a description, a setting or something in progress? Use the imperfect: «Cuando era niño, iba a la playa cada verano», «Llovía y hacía frío». This is the trap for English speakers: English "I used to go" and "I WOULD go every summer" (habit) are both the imperfect «iba», never the conditional «iría»; and "I was walking" is «caminaba». STEP 3: is the action linked to the present or to a period that isn't over (hoy, esta semana, este año, nunca, ya, todavía)? In Spain, use the present perfect: «Hoy he trabajado mucho», «Nunca he estado en Perú». STEP 4: did the action happen before another past moment? Use the pluperfect: «Cuando llegué, el tren ya había salido» (the train had already left). STEP 5: in a story, the imperfect describes the background and the preterite narrates the events: «Mientras caminaba por la calle, vi a un amigo» (While I was walking down the street, I saw a friend). Both fit in one sentence: the imperfect is what was going on; the preterite is what interrupted it. STEP 6: IMPORTANT, varieties: in most of Latin America the preterite replaces the present perfect for recent actions: «Hoy comí temprano», and the perfect is less frequent — much like American English "I already ate". In Spain the distinction is sharper. In both varieties, «ayer», «anoche» and «el año pasado» take the preterite. STEP 7: remember the irregular preterites: fui (ir and ser), hice, dije, tuve, estuve, pude, puse, supe, quise, vine, di, vi, traje. And the imperfect has only three irregulars: ser (era), ir (iba) and ver (veía).
blocos.comparacao: English "When I was a kid, I would go to the beach every summer" uses "would" for a habit, but Spanish uses the imperfect: «iba», not «iría». English "was -ing" for an action in progress is also the imperfect: «caminaba». And as in British English, with «ayer» you can't use the present perfect: «Ayer compré», never «Ayer he comprado».

exemplos.ru: Ayer compré pan en la panadería.
exemplos.pt: Yesterday I bought bread at the bakery.

exemplos.ru: Cuando era niño, iba a la playa cada verano.
exemplos.pt: When I was a child, I used to go to the beach every summer.

exemplos.ru: Cuando llegué, el tren ya había salido.
exemplos.pt: When I arrived, the train had already left.

exemplos.ru: Mientras caminaba por la calle, vi a un amigo.
exemplos.pt: While I was walking down the street, I saw a friend.

exemplos.ru: Llovía y hacía frío cuando salimos.
exemplos.pt: It was raining and cold when we went out.

tabela.marcadores: hoy, esta semana, nunca, ya, todavía

erros.motivo: With «ayer», a finished time, use the preterite.

erros.errado: Cuando era niño, iría a la playa cada verano.
erros.certo: Cuando era niño, iba a la playa cada verano.
erros.motivo: A past habit ("would", "used to") takes the imperfect, not the conditional.

erros.errado: Cuando llegué, el tren ya salió.
erros.certo: Cuando llegué, el tren ya había salido.
erros.motivo: An action before another past one takes the pluperfect.
The action in progress, the one interrupted, goes into the imperfect.

blocos.enunciado: Tell out loud, in 6 sentences, what you did last night (preterite), what your routine was like as a child (imperfect), what you've done today (present perfect) and what you'd already done before going to bed (pluperfect).
Review lesson 60. Say one sentence with the personal «a», one with a verb + preposition and one with an attached pronoun.
